annotations.title: How to get the paid Exit Risk check for a position you hold

description: Free. Returns the URL, price ($0.005) and x402 payment details for the Exit Risk check of a token or pool you already hold, and whether it is in the index. Meant to be called repeatedly while holding, not before buying -- use how_to_buy_verdict for the pre-buy check. It does not pay or take any key; the caller pays with its own x402 client.

token_or_pool_id.description: Token address (0x + 40 hex) or Uniswap v4 pool id (0x + 64 hex), as listed by recent_launches.
